edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Ownable constructor, granting privilege to an arbitrary caller.
Ownable.constructor assigns owner = msg.sender without any validation.
The untrusted caller address flows into the Ownable constructor as ownership source.
The owner state variable is the right-hand operand of require(msg.sender == owner) in onlyOwner.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner access control check.
The onlyOwner check gates execution of renounceOwnership.
The onlyOwner check gates execution of transferOwnership.
The onlyOwner check gates execution of revoke, the privileged refund path.
transferOwnership delegates the privileged ownership write to _transferOwnership.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable, changing privileged control.
_transferOwnership assigns the owner state variable after only a zero-address check.
The owner address is read as the refund recipient in revoke.
The TokenVesting constructor computes cliff = _start.add(_cliff) through SafeMath.add.
Constructor parameter _cliff is an operand of SafeMath.add.
Constructor parameter _start is an operand of SafeMath.add.
The SafeMath.add result determines the cliff state variable.
Constructor parameter _beneficiary is assigned to the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter _start is assigned to the start state variable.
Constructor parameter _duration is assigned to the duration state variable.
Constructor parameter _revocable is assigned to the revocable state variable.
block.timestamp is an untrusted miner-influenceable input that steers vesting decisions.
cliff is read for the block.timestamp < cliff comparison in vestedAmount.
start is read for start.add(duration) and block.timestamp.sub(start) in vestedAmount.
revoked[token] is read to bypass the linear vesting calculation.
released[token] is added to the current balance when computing totalBalance.
vestedAmount calls the external ERC20.balanceOf on the token.
vestedAmount performs the external call token.balanceOf(this) on an untrusted contract.
The token parameter of vestedAmount is the callee of the external balanceOf call.
totalBalance = currentBalance.add(released[token]) uses SafeMath.add.
block.timestamp.sub(start) uses SafeMath.sub.
div(gap) and div(duration) use SafeMath.div for the vesting ratio.
totalBalance.mul(start_gap) uses SafeMath.mul.
vestedAmount computes start_gap by rounding block.timestamp.sub(start) with a hardcoded 3600 gap.
block.timestamp feeds the start_gap rounding arithmetic, making the vesting amount timestamp dependent.
The start_gap local is produced by the timestamp rounding arithmetic.
currentBalance flows into totalBalance before the vesting ratio multiplication.
release starts by querying the view function releasableAmount.
The token parameter of release is forwarded to releasableAmount.
releasableAmount delegates the vesting computation to vestedAmount.
releasableAmount computes vestedAmount(token).sub(released[token]) with SafeMath.sub.
released[token] is the subtrahend of the SafeMath.sub call in releasableAmount.
The releasableAmount result is stored in the unreleased local in release.
release updates released[token] = released[token].add(unreleased) via SafeMath.add.
The unreleased local is an operand of the SafeMath.add that updates the released mapping.
The released mapping value is added to the newly unreleased amount.
release writes the released mapping before pushing tokens out.
release invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on an untrusted token after updating state, allowing re-entrant calls.
The beneficiary state variable is the transfer recipient in release.
The unreleased local amount is the value transferred in release.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer performs the external call token.transfer on an untrusted ERC20.
The token parameter of safeTransfer is the untrusted external callee of token.transfer.
The to parameter of safeTransfer becomes the recipient of token.transfer.
The value parameter of safeTransfer becomes the amount of token.transfer.
revoke reads the contract token balance via ERC20.balanceOf.
The token parameter of revoke is the callee of the balance query.
revoke calls releasableAmount to determine what already vested.
revoke computes refund = balance.sub(unreleased) through SafeMath.sub.
The balance local is the minuend of the SafeMath.sub refund computation.
revoke sets revoked[token] = true before performing the external transfer.
revoke uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer to refund the owner, an external call to an untrusted token.
revoke triggers the external token transfer to the owner inside the privileged path.
The owner address receives the refund during the external call in revoke.
The refund local is the value passed to SafeERC20.safeTransfer in revoke.
SafeMath.mul executes c = a * b and only validates it afterwards with assert(c / a == b).
The first operand a flows into the multiplication that may overflow.
The second operand b flows into the multiplication that may overflow.
The unchecked product is assigned to the local c in SafeMath.mul.
SafeMath.sub executes the subtraction a - b guarded only by assert(b <= a).
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of the subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
SafeMath.add executes c = a + b guarded only by assert(c >= a).
Parameter a is the first addend of the addition in SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is the second addend of the addition in SafeMath.add.
The unchecked sum is assigned to the local c in SafeMath.add.
The TokenVesting fallback immediately reverts, so no value or call can enter the contract through it.

normalization_plan.reason: Operand parameter a only exists to feed the multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
Operand parameter b only exists to feed the multiplication inside SafeMath.mul.
Temporary result c is scoped to and consumed by SafeMath.mul.
Minuend parameter a has no meaning outside SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend parameter b has no meaning outside SafeMath.sub.
Addend parameter a is only used by the SafeMath.add body.
Addend parameter b is only used by the SafeMath.add body.
Temporary result c is scoped to and returned by SafeMath.add.
The token parameter is only the callee of the external transfer performed by SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded to token.transfer inside SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
The amount parameter is only forwarded to token.transfer inside SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Constructor-only parameter immediately written into the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor-only parameter stored into start and used in the cliff addition.
Constructor-only offset parameter consumed by the SafeMath.add that sets cliff.
Constructor-only parameter assigned directly to the duration state variable.
Constructor-only flag assigned directly to the revocable state variable.
The token parameter is used only within release and its callees.
Local unreleased is computed, added to the released mapping and transferred inside release.
The token parameter is used only within revoke for balance query, refund and transfer.
Local balance is read from the token and consumed by the refund subtraction in revoke.
Local refund is the amount transferred back to the owner inside revoke.
The token parameter is only used for the balance and revocation lookups in vestedAmount.
Local currentBalance is derived from the token balance and immediately added into totalBalance.
Local totalBalance exists only to be multiplied by the vesting ratio in vestedAmount.
Local start_gap is the direct result of the timestamp rounding arithmetic, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The _newOwner parameter is only used to write the owner state variable in _transferOwnership.
